name: Uganda

latest_census.notes: National Population and Housing Census 2024 (NPHC 2024). Religion: asked and published nationally -- UBOS on X: 'Catholics form the larger percentage at 37.4% followed by Anglicans at 30.0%. Pentecostals have increased to 14.7% from 11.1%'; ~82% Christian, ~13% Muslim. Ethnicity (tribe): asked and published nationally -- 'Demographics of Uganda' snippet cites 2024 shares (Baganda 15.3%, Banyankore 9.2%, Basoga 8.1%, Iteso 6.9%, Bakiga 6.4%, Langi 5.9%, Bagisu 4.6%, Acholi 4.2%). Caveat: 'In October 2024, UBOS acknowledged errors in the 2024 census results, particularly regarding population figures by tribe and religion' (Independent, SoftPower 'UBOS Explains Data Mismatch on Tribes'), while stating 'there was no error in the number of Catholics, Anglicans, and Muslims' -- any table read from the Final Report needs the corrected version. Language: no result addressed a language question; the check was refused (session search budget exhausted). Subnational: UBOS announced 'district, county/division, and subcounty/town council statistics from the 2024 NPHC' (June 2025) with 'subcounty Excel tables', sub-regional profile reports and 'the anonymised micro dataset'; whether those Excel tables carry religion/tribe columns is not verified. Uganda is NOT in the US Census Bureau subnational series (SOURCES.md).

earlier_census.notes: Main Report (PDF) gives national religion ('Catholics ... close to 40 percent ... Anglicans with 32 percent and Moslems with about 14 percent'). UBOS 'Area Specific Profiles' exist per district as PDFs (e.g. APAC.pdf, SHEEMA.pdf, BUSIA.pdf) covering 'the national, district and sub-county levels'; whether each profile tabulates religion and ethnicity was not visible in snippets. The questionnaire is on UNSD (https://unstats.un.org/unsd/demographic/sources/census/quest/UGA2014enHh.pdf) and would settle which fields were asked, including language.

already_in_map: admin1 (4 regions) 2/4 filled for religion and ethnicity from Afrobarometer Round 9 (a survey; the 'Faith of Unity' label note in SOURCES.md's Afrobarometer section is Ugandan). admin2 (151) holds nothing.
boundary_level_warning: The packet's 151 admin2 shapes do not obviously correspond to one Ugandan level. Of the eight sample names, Dokolo, Kazo, Ntoroko and Soroti are districts, but Bujenje (a county of Masindi District per mindat/GFW), Jie and Pian (counties of Karamoja) are counties, and Rwampara was a county of Mbarara until it became a district in July 2019 (Wikipedia snippet). Before any join, identify which vintage/level the 151 are; the NPHC 2024 release is at district and county/division level, so a matching level exists but names must be matched to the right one.

tier_reason: Counts exist: the 2024 census asked religion and tribe, and UBOS has released statistics at district, county/division and subcounty level including 'subcounty Excel tables' on statistics.ubos.org/nphc. But no snippet confirms that religion or tribe are among the tabulated variables in those Excel files (the official main report is a PDF with acknowledged tribe/religion errors), and the boundary's 151 admin2 units mix district and county names, so the geography match is unresolved. If the Excel tables carry religion/tribe by district or county, this becomes A.
recommended_action: Open https://statistics.ubos.org/nphc/ and download the subcounty/district Excel tables; check for religion and tribe columns. If present, aggregate to the 4 regions for admin1 (superseding the Afrobarometer estimate for 2 regions and filling the other 2) and join to admin2 after first establishing what the 151 boundary units are (compare against UBOS's district list and its county/division list; Bujenje, Jie and Pian are counties, Rwampara has been a district only since July 2019). If the Excel lacks those variables, fall back to the sub-regional profile PDFs (Karamoja example) or the 2014 Area Specific Profiles, both B-grade. Use only the corrected Final Report figures for tribe and religion. Check the UNSD 2014 questionnaire for a language question before declaring language not_collected.

summary: Uganda's 2024 census asked religion and tribe; national results are published (37.4% Catholic, 30.0% Anglican, 14.7% Pentecostal, ~13% Muslim; Baganda 15.3% and so on), with UBOS having acknowledged and corrected errors in the tribe and religion tables of the December 2024 Final Report. In June 2025 UBOS released statistics at district, county/division and subcounty level on statistics.ubos.org/nphc, including subcounty Excel tables and sub-regional profile PDFs, which is the route to fill both the 4 regions (replacing the Afrobarometer survey estimate) and admin2 -- but whether those Excel tables tabulate religion and tribe could not be confirmed before the search budget ran out, and the 2014 fallback is per-district PDF profiles. Separately, the boundary file's 151 admin2 shapes mix district names with county names (Bujenje, Jie, Pian), so the join level must be established before any table is matched. Tier B pending that verification; likely A if the Excel carries the fields.
